info.name: EventParcel API v2
info.description:
# EventParcel API v2

Complete API reference for the EventParcel backend.

## Base URL
Set the `baseUrl` collection variable to your environment, e.g.:
- **Local:** `http://localhost:5000/api/v1`
- **Staging:** `https://staging.eventparcel.com/api/v1`
- **Production:** `https://api.eventparcel.com/api/v1`

## Authentication
Most endpoints require a Bearer token. Set the `adminToken` or `userToken` collection variable after logging in.

```
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```

## Response Format
All responses follow the structure:
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "statusCode": 200,
  "message": "Human-readable message",
  "data": { ... }
}
```

## Error Format
```json
{
  "success": false,
  "statusCode": 400,
  "message": "Error description"
}
```

item.name: States & Cities
item.description:
Admin endpoints for managing Nigerian states and cities used in delivery fee lookups and order pickup details.

> **All routes in this folder (except Get Delivery-Covered States) require admin authentication.**

### Key Concepts
- States and cities use **soft-delete** — deleting sets `status: "inactive"` rather than removing the document.
- A state has a `deliveryCovered` flag that controls whether the delivery fee system covers it.
- City names are stored alongside a `normalizedName` (lowercase, trimmed) for case-insensitive matching.
- When creating a state or city that was previously deleted (inactive), the record is **re-activated** instead of creating a duplicate.

request.description:
Creates a new state.

**Auth:** Admin Bearer token required.

**Body Fields:**
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `name` | string | ✅ | State name (e.g. `"Lagos"`). Will be stored as-is; `normalizedName` is derived automatically. |

**Behaviour:**
- If a state with the same `normalizedName` already exists and is `inactive`, it is re-activated.
- Returns `409 Conflict` if an active state with the same name already exists.

**Success Response — 201:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "statusCode": 201,
  "message": "State created successfully.",
  "data": {
    "_id": "664f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d",
    "name": "Lagos",
    "normalizedName": "lagos",
    "status": "active",
    "deliveryCovered": false
  }
}
```

Soft-deletes a state by setting its `status` to `"inactive"`.

**Auth:** Admin Bearer token required.

**Path Params:**
| Param | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `stateId` | MongoDB ObjectId of the state |

**Note:** The state's cities are NOT automatically deactivated. Deactivate them individually if needed.

**Success Response — 200:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "statusCode": 200,
  "message": "State deleted successfully."
}
```

Toggles the `deliveryCovered` boolean flag on a state. If it is currently `false` it becomes `true`, and vice versa.

**Auth:** Admin Bearer token required.

**Path Params:**
| Param | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `stateId` | MongoDB ObjectId of the state |

**No request body required.**

**Use Case:** The delivery fee computation will only apply to states where `deliveryCovered: true`. Disable a state's coverage to exclude it from the delivery fee system without deleting its data.

**Success Response — 200:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "statusCode": 200,
  "message": "Delivery coverage enabled for Lagos.",
  "data": {
    "deliveryCovered": true
  }
}
```

Creates a new city under the specified state.

**Auth:** Admin Bearer token required.

**Path Params:**
| Param | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `stateId` | MongoDB ObjectId of the parent state |

**Body Fields:**
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `name` | string | ✅ | City name (e.g. `"Ikeja"`) |

**Behaviour:**
- If a city with the same `normalizedName` under the same state already exists but is `inactive`, it is re-activated.
- Returns `409 Conflict` if an active city with the same name already exists in this state.

**Note:** Create a city named `"Others"` in each state as a catch-all for the delivery fee fallback logic.

**Success Response — 201:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "statusCode": 201,
  "message": "City created successfully.",
  "data": {
    "_id": "664f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c1a",
    "name": "Ikeja",
    "normalizedName": "ikeja",
    "stateId": "664f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d",
    "status": "active"
  }
}
```

Returns all **active** cities belonging to the specified state.

**Auth:** Admin Bearer token required.

**Path Params:**
| Param | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `stateId` | MongoDB ObjectId of the parent state |

**Success Response — 200:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "statusCode": 200,
  "message": "Cities fetched successfully.",
  "data": {
    "cities": [
      {
        "_id": "664f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c1a",
        "name": "Ikeja",
        "normalizedName": "ikeja",
        "stateId": "664f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d",
        "status": "active"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

Soft-deletes a city by setting its `status` to `"inactive"`.

**Auth:** Admin Bearer token required.

**Path Params:**
| Param | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `stateId` | MongoDB ObjectId of the parent state |
| `cityId` | MongoDB ObjectId of the city |

**Success Response — 200:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "statusCode": 200,
  "message": "City deleted successfully."
}
```

item.name: Delivery Fees
item.description:
Admin endpoints for managing the delivery fee matrix between pickup states/cities and destination states/cities.

> **All routes require admin authentication.**

### How the Delivery Fee System Works

The delivery fee is computed by looking up a combination of:
- **Pickup State** → the host's pickup location state
- **Pickup City** → the host's pickup location city
- **Destination State** → the guest's delivery address state
- **Destination City** → the guest's delivery address city

If an exact 4-way match is not found, the system falls back through progressively broader lookups:
1. Pickup state + city → destination state + **"Others"** city
2. Pickup state + **"Others"** city → destination state + destination city
3. Pickup state + **"Others"** city → destination state + **"Others"** city

### Recommended Workflow for Bulk Import
1. `GET /admin/delivery-fees/template` → download the Excel template
2. Fill in the template with fee data
3. `POST /admin/delivery-fees/import` → upload filled template, review the preview response
4. `POST /admin/delivery-fees/import/:importId/confirm` → confirm with chosen `mode`

### Soft Delete
Deleting a delivery fee sets `status: "inactive"`. If you later create the same combination, it is re-activated.

request.description:
Downloads a pre-formatted Excel (`.xlsx`) template for bulk delivery fee import.

**Auth:** Admin Bearer token required.

**Response:** Binary `.xlsx` file download.

**Template Columns:**
| Column | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| Pickup State | Name of the pickup state (must match an existing active state) |
| Pickup City | Name of the pickup city (must match an active city under Pickup State) |
| Destination State | Name of the destination state |
| Destination City | Name of the destination city |
| Fee (₦) | Delivery fee amount in Naira (number) |

> The template includes dropdown validation for state/city columns populated from the active states and cities in your database.

formdata.description: Filled delivery fee Excel template (.xlsx). Must be multipart/form-data with key 'file'.

request.description:
Parses an uploaded Excel file and returns a **preview** of what will be imported — no data is written to the database yet.

**Auth:** Admin Bearer token required.

**Request:** `multipart/form-data` with a single `file` field containing the `.xlsx` file.

**Each row in the response is classified as:**
| `rowStatus` | Meaning |
|------------|----------|
| `new` | This combination does not exist; will be inserted |
| `duplicate` | An active record for this combination already exists; will be skipped on `merge` mode or replaced on `replace_all` mode |
| `inactive_match` | An inactive (deleted) record exists; it will be re-activated |

**Save the `importId` from the response** — you need it to confirm the import.

**Success Response — 200:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "statusCode": 200,
  "message": "Preview ready.",
  "data": {
    "importId": "664f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c2b",
    "totalRows": 12,
    "newRows": 8,
    "duplicateRows": 3,
    "inactiveMatchRows": 1,
    "rows": [
      {
        "rowNumber": 2,
        "pickupStateLabel": "Lagos",
        "pickupCityLabel": "Ikeja",
        "destinationStateLabel": "Abuja",
        "destinationCityLabel": "Garki",
        "fee": 3500,
        "rowStatus": "new",
        "pickupStateId": "664f...0d",
        "pickupCityId": "664f...1a",
        "destinationStateId": "664f...2b",
        "destinationCityId": "664f...3c"
      }
    ],
    "expiresAt": "2026-04-11T13:00:00.000Z"
  }
}
```

> **Note:** The import session expires after 10 minutes. Confirm before it expires.

Commits a previously uploaded import session to the database.

**Auth:** Admin Bearer token required.

**Path Params:**
| Param | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `importId` | The `importId` returned by the Import Preview endpoint |

**Body Fields:**
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `mode` | string | ✅ | Import strategy. See below. |

**Import Modes:**
| Mode | Behaviour |
|------|-----------|
| `merge` | Only inserts `new` and re-activates `inactive_match` rows. Skips existing duplicates. |
| `replace_all` | Deactivates ALL existing active delivery fees first, then inserts everything from the file as fresh records. |

**Success Response — 200:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "statusCode": 200,
  "message": "Import confirmed. 9 records processed.",
  "data": {
    "processed": 9
  }
}
```

Creates a single delivery fee entry manually.

**Auth:** Admin Bearer token required.

**Body Fields:**
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `pickupStateId` | ObjectId | ✅ | MongoDB ID of the pickup state |
| `pickupCityId` | ObjectId | ✅ | MongoDB ID of the pickup city |
| `destinationStateId` | ObjectId | ✅ | MongoDB ID of the destination state |
| `destinationCityId` | ObjectId | ✅ | MongoDB ID of the destination city |
| `fee` | number | ✅ | Fee amount in Naira |

**Behaviour:**
- Returns `409 Conflict` if an active fee for this exact combination already exists.
- If an `inactive` record for the same combination exists, it is re-activated with the new fee.

**Success Response — 201:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "statusCode": 201,
  "message": "Delivery fee created.",
  "data": { ... }
}
```

Updates an existing delivery fee record.

**Auth:** Admin Bearer token required.

**Path Params:**
| Param | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `deliveryFeeId` | MongoDB ObjectId of the delivery fee record |

**Body Fields (all optional):**
| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `pickupStateId` | ObjectId | New pickup state ID |
| `pickupCityId` | ObjectId | New pickup city ID |
| `destinationStateId` | ObjectId | New destination state ID |
| `destinationCityId` | ObjectId | New destination city ID |
| `fee` | number | Updated fee in Naira |

**Note:** If the updated combination clashes with an existing active fee record, a `409 Conflict` is returned.

**Success Response — 200:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "statusCode": 200,
  "message": "Delivery fee updated.",
  "data": { ... }
}
```

Soft-deletes a delivery fee record by setting its `status` to `"inactive"`.

**Auth:** Admin Bearer token required.

**Path Params:**
| Param | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `deliveryFeeId` | MongoDB ObjectId of the delivery fee record |

**Success Response — 200:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "statusCode": 200,
  "message": "Delivery fee deleted."
}
```

item.name: Payment & Delivery (Host)
item.description:
Endpoints for hosts to create and manage payment & delivery configuration for their events.

These endpoints record:
- Payout account details (Naira / Dollar)
- Payment deadline date/time
- Pickup location (address + lat/lng)
- **Pickup State & City** (now stored as MongoDB ObjectIds referencing the `State` and `City` collections)
- Delivery deadline date/time

### State & City IDs
When providing `state` and `city` in the request body, you must pass **MongoDB ObjectIds** from the State and City collections — **not plain text strings**.

To get valid IDs:
1. Call `GET /api/v1/states/delivery-covered` for delivery-covered states
2. Call `GET /api/v1/admin/states/:stateId/cities` for cities under a state

body.raw:
{
  "event": "664f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0a",
  "paymentDate": "2026-05-01",
  "paymentTime": "18:00",
  "paymentTimeZone": "Africa/Lagos",
  "contactName": "John Doe",
  "contactPhoneNumber": "08012345678",
  "pickupLocation": "12 Adeola Odeku Street, Victoria Island",
  "pickupLatitude": "6.4281",
  "pickupLongitude": "3.4219",
  "state": "664f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d",
  "city": "664f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c1a",
  "deliveryDate": "2026-05-10",
  "deliveryTime": "12:00",
  "deliveryTimeZone": "Africa/Lagos",
  "isDraft": false,
  "nairaAccount": {
    "accountNumber": "0123456789",
    "bankName": "Access Bank",
    "accountName": "John Doe",
    "bankCode": "044"
  }
}

request.description:
Creates a new Payment & Delivery configuration for an event.

**Auth:** Host Bearer token required.

**Body Fields:**
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `event` | ObjectId | ✅ | MongoDB ID of the event |
| `paymentDate` | string | ✅ | Payment deadline date (`YYYY-MM-DD`) |
| `paymentTime` | string | ✅ | Payment deadline time (`HH:mm`) |
| `paymentTimeZone` | string | ✅ | IANA timezone string (e.g. `"Africa/Lagos"`) |
| `contactName` | string | ✅ | Pickup contact person name |
| `contactPhoneNumber` | string | ✅ | Pickup contact phone number (Nigerian format accepted) |
| `pickupLocation` | string | ✅ | Human-readable pickup address |
| `pickupLatitude` | string | ⬜ | Latitude of pickup location |
| `pickupLongitude` | string | ⬜ | Longitude of pickup location |
| `state` | ObjectId | ✅* | MongoDB ObjectId of the pickup state (*required if event has `isPickUp` or `isPlatformDelivery`) |
| `city` | ObjectId | ✅* | MongoDB ObjectId of the pickup city (*required if event has `isPickUp` or `isPlatformDelivery`) |
| `deliveryDate` | string | ✅ | Delivery deadline date (`YYYY-MM-DD`) |
| `deliveryTime` | string | ✅ | Delivery deadline time (`HH:mm`) |
| `deliveryTimeZone` | string | ✅ | IANA timezone string |
| `isDraft` | boolean | ⬜ | Set `true` to save as draft without publishing |
| `nairaAccount` | object | ✅* | Required if event has `isNairaAccount: true` |
| `dollarAccount` | object | ✅* | Required if event has `isDollarAccount: true` |

**`nairaAccount` object:**
```json
{
  "accountNumber": "0123456789",
  "bankName": "Access Bank",
  "accountName": "John Doe",
  "bankCode": "044"
}
```

**`dollarAccount` object:**
```json
{
  "usAccountNumber": "000123456789",
  "routingNumber": "021000021",
  "usBankName": "Chase Bank",
  "usAccountName": "John Doe"
}
```

**Validation Rules:**
- `paymentDate` must be in the future and before the event date
- `deliveryDate` must be in the future and before the event date
- `state` and `city` must be valid MongoDB ObjectIds when provided
- Bank account details are validated against Paystack before saving

**Success Response — 201:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "statusCode": 201,
  "message": "Payment and Delivery record created successfully!",
  "data": { ... }
}
```

Updates an existing Payment & Delivery record for an event. If no record exists, one is created.

**Auth:** Host Bearer token required.

**Path Params:**
| Param | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `eventId` | MongoDB ObjectId of the event |

**Body Fields (all optional — only send fields to update):**
| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `state` | ObjectId | Updated pickup state ID |
| `city` | ObjectId | Updated pickup city ID |
| `paymentDate` | string | Updated payment deadline date |
| `paymentTime` | string | Updated payment deadline time |
| `deliveryDate` | string | Updated delivery date |
| `deliveryTime` | string | Updated delivery time |
| `contactName` | string | Updated contact name |
| `contactPhoneNumber` | string | Updated contact phone |
| `pickupLocation` | string | Updated pickup address |
| `nairaAccount` | object | Updated Naira payout details |
| `dollarAccount` | object | Updated Dollar payout details |

**Note:** `state` and `city` must be valid MongoDB ObjectIds.

**Success Response — 200:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "statusCode": 200,
  "message": "Payment and Delivery record updated successfully!",
  "data": { ... }
}
```

item.name: Delivery Fee Audit Logs
item.description:
Admin endpoint for querying the `AdminDeliveryFeeAuditLog` collection.

> **Requires admin authentication.**

### What is logged?
Every create, update, and delete action performed through the following endpoints is automatically recorded:

| Endpoint | Action | Resource |
|----------|--------|----------|
| Create State | `create` | `state` |
| Delete State | `delete` | `state` |
| Toggle Delivery Coverage | `update` | `state` |
| Create City | `create` | `city` |
| Delete City | `delete` | `city` |
| Confirm Import | `create` | `delivery_fee_import` |
| Create Delivery Fee | `create` | `delivery_fee` |
| Update Delivery Fee | `update` | `delivery_fee` |
| Delete Delivery Fee | `delete` | `delivery_fee` |

### Log Entry Shape
```json
{
  "_id": "664f...",
  "action": "create",
  "performedBy": {
    "_id": "664f...",
    "firstName": "Super",
    "lastName": "Admin",
    "email": "admin@eventparcel.com"
  },
  "resource": "state",
  "resourceId": "664f...",
  "details": { "name": "Lagos" },
  "createdAt": "2026-04-21T10:00:00.000Z"
}
```

query.description: Filter by resource type: state | city | delivery_fee | delivery_fee_import
Filter by action: create | update | delete
End date filter (YYYY-MM-DD). Inclusive (end of day).

request.description:
Returns a paginated list of audit log entries for all delivery-fee-related admin actions.

**Auth:** Admin Bearer token required.

**Query Params (all optional):**
| Param | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `resource` | string | Filter by resource: `state` \| `city` \| `delivery_fee` \| `delivery_fee_import` |
| `action` | string | Filter by action: `create` \| `update` \| `delete` |
| `from` | string | Start date `YYYY-MM-DD` (inclusive) |
| `to` | string | End date `YYYY-MM-DD` (inclusive, covers full day) |
| `page` | number | Page number, default `1` |
| `limit` | number | Items per page, default `20`, max `100` |

**Success Response — 200:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "statusCode": 200,
  "message": "Audit logs fetched successfully.",
  "data": {
    "logs": [
      {
        "_id": "664f...",
        "action": "delete",
        "performedBy": {
          "_id": "664f...",
          "firstName": "Super",
          "lastName": "Admin",
          "email": "admin@eventparcel.com"
        },
        "resource": "delivery_fee",
        "resourceId": "664f...",
        "details": {
          "pickupState": "664f...0d",
          "pickupCity": "664f...1a",
          "destinationState": "664f...2b",
          "destinationCity": "664f...3c"
        },
        "createdAt": "2026-04-21T10:00:00.000Z"
      }
    ],
    "total": 47,
    "page": 1,
    "limit": 20,
    "totalPages": 3
  }
}
```
